Grand Theft Auto VI has 18.2M Spotify monthly listeners and only six songs, and it gained 468.0K listeners in a single day (Oct 15, 2026). 🎮

The page is home to GTAVI: The Album, with six tracks and 59.2M total streams: Morgan Wallen's "Last Thing You Need" (20.5M), Travis Scott's "RHYNO" (12.4M), Rauw Alejandro's "Macacoa 2000" (9.9M) and "Sexy Magic" with CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress and Fred again.. (9.7M).

The Hunger Games page is the other surprise: 6.1M listeners (+275.3K in a day) built on one song, Noah Kahan's "Draw You Out" (14.3M streams). Among the biggest one-day gainers: ADÉLA +513.2K, Ashe +511.1K, SIENNA SPIRO +260.1K, Jamie Miller +249.8K (9.9M listeners).

Which soundtrack page do you think grows next? 👇
